Common.CollectorKeyRole.description:
Collector API key roles. Every key sent in `x-otlp-api-key` carries one or
more roles: `ingest` accepts OTLP, `read` serves the query routes, `write`
creates and updates user resources, and `delete` deletes them. Roles are
independent, so a leaked ingest key can neither read, change nor delete
anything.

tool surface; `qyl:write` adds the create and update tools; `qyl:delete`
adds the one delete tool. No scope deletes telemetry.

OTel.Enums.SeverityNumber.description: Log severity number following OTel specification (1-24)

OTel.Enums.SpanKind.description: Span kind describing the relationship between spans

time_unix_nano.description: Timestamp when the event occurred (nanoseconds since epoch). Absent when the source timestamp is unknown; use observed_time_unix_nano as the display fallback when present.

observed_time_unix_nano.description: Timestamp when the log was observed/collected (nanoseconds since epoch). Absent when a historical record did not capture it.

severity_text.description: Severity text exactly as supplied by the producer; classification uses severity_number.

body.description: Log body: the OTLP AnyValue, projected exactly like an attribute value

event_name.description: Optional event category whose presence identifies this log record as an event; records with the same name are expected to share one body and attribute schema.

resource.description: Resource describing the entity that produced this log

OTel.Metrics.MetricAggregation.description: Server-side reducer applied to the points falling in one time bucket.

OTel.Metrics.MetricAttributeMatcher.description:
One structured attribute matcher. Tool inputs and saved queries carry
matchers in this form; the HTTP routes keep their `key=value` string
parameters, and a client serializes each matcher to one of them.

bucket_start.description: Inclusive start of the bucket, aligned to the query's step from the query's start.

value.description:
The aggregation applied to the points in this bucket. Null when the bucket
holds no value: either no point landed in it, or every point that did was
an OTLP `NO_RECORDED_VALUE` marker.

point_count.description: Number of stored points folded into this bucket.

OTel.Metrics.MetricBucket.description: One aggregated time bucket of a metric range query.

OTel.Metrics.MetricCount.description: An unsigned OTLP count encoded as a decimal string to preserve all 64 bits.

has_conflict.description: Whether this resource/scope/name group contains incompatible recorded descriptors. The conflicts array lists the actual variants.

instrument_id.description: Stable catalog group identifier, derived from resource, instrumentation scope and metric name.

resource.description: Resource that owns this metric group, when recorded.

instrumentation_scope.description: Instrumentation scope that owns this metric group, when recorded.

monotonic.description: Whether a sum only ever increases. Meaningless for other kinds.

unit.description: UCUM unit as reported by the producer, e.g. `s` or `{request}`.

series_count.description: Number of distinct attribute streams recorded under this name.

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the most recent point recorded under this name.

OTel.Metrics.MetricDescriptor.description:
One resource, instrumentation scope and metric name recorded for a project.
Incompatible instrument descriptors within that group are reported as conflicts.
The primary descriptor is an actual recorded variant, never a combination of variants.

OTel.Metrics.MetricExemplar.description: One original metric exemplar, in producer order.

OTel.Metrics.MetricExponentialBuckets.description: Native exponential-histogram buckets. Each count corresponds to offset plus its array index.

OTel.Metrics.MetricExponentialHistogramP.description: An original exponential histogram. Its native scale and buckets are never reconstructed from explicit bounds.

OTel.Metrics.MetricHistogramPointData.description: An original explicit histogram, before any query projection or interpolation.

OTel.Metrics.MetricKind.description: Shape of a stored metric stream.

OTel.Metrics.MetricMatcherOp.description: How a structured attribute matcher compares an attribute value.

OTel.Metrics.MetricNumberPointData.description: The numeric oneof of a gauge or sum point.

OTel.Metrics.MetricNumberValue.description: A numeric OTLP value. Integers preserve all signed 64 bits; doubles retain named non-finite values.

observation_id.description: Stable identifier of this original observation. Identical export retries retain the same identity.

has_conflict.description: Whether a different measurement was recorded at the same series timestamp. Exemplar or metadata enrichment alone is not a measurement conflict.

start_time_unix_nano.description: Start timestamp when known; an omitted start is never replaced with an invented interval.

historical_exemplar_trace_ids.description: Trace links retained by an older collector that did not record complete exemplars. These do not claim a known exemplar value, timestamp, span or attributes.

instrument_metadata.description: Original non-identifying instrument metadata attached to this point's export.

resource_dropped_attributes_count.description: Resource attribute drop count from this observation's export; absent on historical records that did not retain it.

scope_dropped_attributes_count.description: Instrumentation scope attribute drop count from this observation's export; absent on historical records that did not retain it.

projection_unavailable_reason.description: Why this original point cannot be represented by the derived aggregate projection, when applicable.

OTel.Metrics.MetricPoint.description:
A stored point from one exact metric series. Null data means an older record did
not retain the original representation; the collector does not invent it from
normalized values. Absent flags, exemplars or metadata mean historically unknown,
while zero flags and an empty array are known producer values on new records.

OTel.Metrics.MetricPointData.description: The original typed OTLP point data, independent of the collector's derived aggregate columns.

OTel.Metrics.MetricPointProjection.description: A derived, potentially approximate query projection. This is not the original OTLP point.

OTel.Metrics.MetricQuantileValue.description: An original summary quantile and its producer-supplied estimate.

numeric_representation.description: Aggregate buckets use a potentially approximate float64 projection. Read original points for exact signed int64 and native histogram data.

approximate.description: Whether the reducer estimates or interpolates values, beyond the stated numeric representation.

name.description: Instrument name the query ran against.

step_ms.description: Bucket width actually used, which may be widened from the requested step.

truncated.description: Whether streams were dropped because the result exceeded the series limit.

OTel.Metrics.MetricQueryResult.description: The answer to a metric range query: what was asked, and the streams it produced.

series_id.description: Stable identifier for this stream, derived from its instrument descriptor, attributes, resource and instrumentation scope.

name.description: Instrument name this series belongs to.

attributes.description: The attributes that distinguish this series from others under the same name.

resource.description: Resource that emitted this stream, with its attributes and schema URL.

instrumentation_scope.description: Instrumentation scope that owns this instrument; distinct scopes never merge into one series.

OTel.Metrics.MetricSeries.description: One distinct attribute stream recorded under a metric name.

attributes.description: The grouping key that produced this stream.

OTel.Metrics.MetricSeriesResult.description:
One result stream of a metric range query. With no `group_by` the whole
result is a single stream whose `attributes` are empty; with `group_by` there
is one stream per distinct combination of the requested attribute values.

OTel.Metrics.MetricSummaryPointData.description: An original OTLP summary. Query reducers must explicitly support summaries rather than invent histogram buckets.

OTel.Metrics.MetricTemporality.description: How successive points of a sum or histogram relate to each other.

service_name.description: Service name used by the Collector's service queries.

dropped_attributes_count.description: Number of resource attributes dropped by the producer.
